items: CMA CGM closes $1.4B FedEx Supply Chain purchase. CMA CGM completed the acquisition at an enterprise value of $1.4 billion, and FedEx Supply Chain warehouse operations move to its CEVA Logistics unit. The companies also signed multi-year ocean and air freight agreements, and no change to FedEx parcel rates or service is stated.

FedEx tariff charge suits consolidated in Memphis. Thirteen proposed class actions over duties and tariff-related charges billed on imported shipments are combined as In re FedEx Tariff Litigation in the Western District of Tennessee. A consolidated complaint is proposed for Nov. 4 and FedEx's response for Dec. 4; the allegations are unproven and no class has been certified.

Canada Post sets GTA community mailbox conversion schedule. Conversions from home delivery begin later this month with 18,000 Etobicoke addresses, and the last areas are scheduled for 2031. Canada Post also said weekend parcel delivery to GTA community mailboxes and post offices begins this weekend.
